## Objective
Fix the four store write-path integrity gaps (audit M6), test-first, without behavior changes beyond integrity.

## Design summary
Pre-decided conventions from the ticket, with line evidence corrected in-session:
1. Locked dedup: write_smart_store_note/suggest_store_action (memento/smart_store.py L249/L408) do check-then-write with no internal lock - today only callers hold acquire_vault_write_lock (memento/store.py L532/L556). Make the dedup-check-plus-write atomic under that existing lock inside the write path (re-entrant safe if callers already hold it - check the lock implementation first).
2. Unique tmp names: three write paths use slug-derived tmp names that collide across concurrent same-slug writers - store.py L969 (write_note), L1021 (replace_note_at_path), L1166 (write_daily_snapshot). Use unique per-writer names (pid+random suffix or tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile in the target dir) followed by atomic os.replace.
3. Atomic project index: update_project_index (store.py L1188-1224) writes via project_file.write_text directly. Switch to tmp + os.replace like every other write path.
4. Frontmatter: _split_note_text (smart_store.py:56) uses split('---', 2), so a body '---' fabricates frontmatter. Only a LEADING '---' block is frontmatter; rewrites must round-trip unknown frontmatter keys unchanged. (Note: this logic lives ONLY in smart_store.py - the ticket's store.py references were stale.)
Order: failing tests first - same-slug parallel writers, body containing '---', rewrite preserving an unknown frontmatter key - then the fixes.

## File scope
Include: memento/smart_store.py, memento/store.py, tests/test_store.py, tests/test_smart_store.py. Exclude: queue lock (MEM-123), search/scoring (MEM-127).

## Constraints
All gates run via .venv/bin/python (bare python3 lacks pytest/ruff here - probed). If an acceptance criterion is ambiguous, pause and ask. No remote writes.

## Verification
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_store.py tests/test_smart_store.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check .
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_llm_backends.py tests/test_lifecycle.py tests/test_triage.py tests/test_store.py tests/test_frontmatter_schema.py tests/test_script_harnesses.py tests/test_beislid_workflow_gates.py
